mechanism_failures: A possessive planner anchor lost its apostrophe during normalization, so Elizabeth Berg's did not bind Elizabeth Berg and an auditable local two-edge path was missed.
A country-to-affiliated-organization tuple could not project its typed subject for an inverse affiliation question because the subject was already a dependency-bound descriptor.
Final answer projection still preferred the evidence verifier's answer_position over the stronger controller query certificate.

architectural_delta.possessive_alias: Multi-token possessive anchors match their non-possessive entity form under a deterministic one-character suffix rule.
architectural_delta.inverse_role: A bound typed subject may be projected only for a certified possession/affiliation inverse relation whose other endpoint has an explicit lexical role match in the subgoal.
architectural_delta.projection_authority: Controller-certificate answer_position controls final semantic grouping when a complete certificate exists; evidence scoring remains unchanged.

stop_condition: Continue generic no-training diagnosis and iteration after any development failure. Stop only on the full preregistered HARA gate plus committed safe-stop report, or before the next call would exceed the shared 2000-attempt/2000000-token hard cap.
